objective: Preallocate composite index prefixes from table and column name lengths without intermediate joined-column allocation.

tasks.title: Preallocate composite index prefixes
tasks.result: Composite index key and scan prefix construction now uses one explicit-capacity String instead of columns.join(",") plus format!.

verification.status: passed: helper 1/1 and matching sql_index_cache regression 1/1

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for index:<table>:<comma-separated-columns>: from known table and column name lengths.
The optimization removes the intermediate columns.join(",") allocation in composite_index_prefix().
Generated prefix bytes, composite index keys, scan prefixes, range scans, SHOW INDEXES output, and SQL results are unchanged.
